description: If user mentions a fee higher than statutory, flag it

message.en: You mentioned {user_amount} UGX. The legal fee is {statutory_fee} UGX. You do not need to pay more.
message.lg: Oyogedde ku UGX {user_amount}. Ssente entuufu ng'etteeka bwe ligamba UGX {statutory_fee}. Toweetaaga kusasula nnyo.
message.sw: Umetaja UGX {user_amount}. Ada halali ni UGX {statutory_fee}. Huhitaji kulipa zaidi.

description: If user mentions going to the wrong authority, flag it

message.en: You mentioned going to {user_authority}. For this matter, the correct authority is {correct_authority}.
message.lg: Oyogedde ku kugenda ewa {user_authority}. Ku nsonga eno, ekifo ekituufu {correct_authority}.
message.sw: Umetaja kwenda kwa {user_authority}. Kwa jambo hili, mamlaka sahihi ni {correct_authority}.

description: If user describes a criminal act but mentions LC1, redirect to police
trigger: category is safety AND user mentions LC1

message.en: DO NOT go to LC1 for this. This is a criminal matter. Go to the nearest police station or call 112 immediately.
message.lg: TOGENDA ku LC1 ku kino. Kino kya bubbi. Genda ku poliisi erisinga okumpi oba okubire 112 mangu.
message.sw: USIENDE kwa LC1 kwa hili. Hili ni shauri la jinai. Nenda kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu au pigia 112 mara moja.
